attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 24, `fadA` to `rarD` through the `tat` and `ubi` genes, are spine columns carried by 98 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and 0 to 27% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 34 to 100% of genes, mean 95%, fewest at column 20 (`rhtC`), named 34%, and most hesitant at column 14 (`metE`), 0.43 bits.

**The first fork is at `yigG` and `yigF`.** Columns 25 to 26 are fork columns, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 31 to 33% of calls; the model names 88 to 90%, mean 89%, and hesitates most at column 25, 0.70 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. The branches carry `yigG` in 67% of chromosomes, an allophanate hydrolase-related protein in 25% and an IS1-like element transposase in 13%, then `yigF` in 66% and a cytosine permease in 25%.

**A second spine runs from `corA` to `hemY`.** Columns 27 to 41 are spine, carried by 93 to 99%, all persistent, 1 to 29% of calls in a region of plasticity; the model names 50 to 97%, mean 89%, fewest at column 28 (`ysgD`), named 50%, and most hesitant at column 36 (`cyaY`), 0.46 bits. Column 42, `aslA`, is variable, 5% in a region of plasticity, named 89%.

**Then a spine of 18 columns, `aslB` to `rhlB`**, carried by 90 to 99%, all persistent, 0.2 to 3% in a region of plasticity, where the model names 94 to 99%, mean 97%. The window ends in fork and variable columns 61 to 79, 0.2 to 1% in a region of plasticity, named 89 to 99%, mean 97%: `gppA` and `rep` at 88%, `ppiC` at 86% with `yifO` at 43%, then the `ilv` genes from 82% down to 72%, and `rbsK` at 32%, where the window ends.

**Across the window the model names 95% of genes**, 0.17 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.49 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%; 2,933 of 42,960 calls are inside one.

label: fadA
facts:
WINDOW: the fadA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor fadA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,280 to 4,359 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying fadA once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.17 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,146 calls, named 97%, 0.11 bits; shell 4,698 calls, named 79%, 0.63 bits; cloud 116 calls, named 2%, 2.70 bits. Outside an RGP 40,027 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 2,933 calls, named 85%, 0.49 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 3 fork, 19 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.49 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 2,933 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 25 (yigG) 0.70 bits, RGP 33%; column 36 (cyaY) 0.46 bits, RGP 2%; column 42 (aslA) 0.46 bits, RGP 5%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 25-26 (fork), RGP 31-33%; the least: columns 61-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-24 (25 columns) spine: share 98-100%, all P, RGP 0-27%. Genes: fadA, fre, ubiD, rfaH, tatD, tatC, tatB "Sec-independent protein translocase…", tatA, ubiB "ubiquinone biosynthesis regulatory…", ubiJ, ubiE, rmuC, udp, ysgA, metE, metR "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", bioP, yigL "HAD-IIB family hydrolase", pldB, rhtB "LysE family transporter", rhtC, recQ, pldA, yigI "acyl-CoA thioesterase YigI", rarD. named 34-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 20 (rhtC), named 34%; most hesitant at column 14 (metE), 0.43 bits.
2. columns 25-26 (2 columns) fork: RGP 31-33%. named 88-90% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 26, named 88%; most hesitant at column 25, 0.70 bits.
   25: yigG S 67% "protein YigG"; also "allophanate hydrolase-related protein" S 25%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 13%
   26: yigF S 66% "DUF2628 domain-containing protein"; also "cytosine permease" S 25%
3. columns 27-41 (15 columns) spine: share 93-99%, all P, RGP 1-29%. Genes: corA, ysgD "protein YsgD", yigE, uvrD, yigB "5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino…", xerC, yigA "DUF484 domain-containing protein", dapF, lptM, cyaY, cyaA "class I adenylate cyclase", hemC, hemD "uroporphyrinogen-III synthase", hemX, hemY. named 50-97% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 28 (ysgD), named 50%; most hesitant at column 36 (cyaY), 0.46 bits.
4. column 42 variable: RGP 5%. named 89%; 0.46 bits.
   42: aslA S 80%
5. columns 43-60 (18 columns) spine: share 90-99%, all P, RGP 0.2-3%. Genes: aslB "anaerobic sulfatase maturase", thrP, wecG, wzyE, rffT, wzxE, rffA "dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxygalactose t…", rffC, rfbA, rffG, wecC "UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine dehydrog…", wecB, wzzE, wecA, rho, rhoL, trxA, rhlB. named 94-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43 (aslB), named 94%, 0.32 bits.
6. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.2-1%. named 89-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 63, named 89%, 0.35 bits.
   61 variable: gppA P 88%
   62 variable: rep P 88%
   63 fork: ppiC P 86%; also yifO S 43%
   columns 64-79 variable, share 32-82%, all P: ilvC 82%, ilvY 80%, ilvA 77%, ilvD 76%, ilvE 75%, ilvM 75%, ilvG "acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic s…" 73%, ilvX 72%, ilvL 72%, yifB "YifB family Mg chelatase-like AAA A…" 65%, maoP 67%, hdfR 64%, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…" 59%, mdtD 52%, rbsR "ribose operon transcriptional repre…" 46%, rbsK 32%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): tatD 3'-5' ssDNA/RNA exonuclease TatD; tatC twin-arginine translocase subunit TatC; tatA Sec-independent protein translocase sub…; ubiJ ubiquinone biosynthesis protein UbiJ; ubiE class I SAM-dependent methyltransferase; rhtC LysE family transporter; hemC porphobilinogen deaminase; hemX uroporphyrinogen-III C-methyltransferase; hemY tetratricopeptide repeat protein; aslA arylsulfatase; rffC dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose ac…; rho transcription termination factor Rho; ilvC ketol-acid reductoisomerase; ilvY HTH-type transcriptional activator IlvY; ilvA pyridoxal-phosphate dependent enzyme; ilvD dihydroxy-acid dehydratase domain-conta…; ilvE branched-chain-amino-acid transaminase; ilvM acetolactate synthase 2 small subunit; rbsK PfkB family carbohydrate kinase; arcC carbamate kinase; tkt transketolase family protein; hxlB 6-phospho-3-hexuloisomerase; yifO type II toxin-antitoxin system PemK/Maz…
END: the window ends at column 79, rbsK, in 32% of chromosomes.
